fuelTypes.name: XP100
fuelTypes.significance: Ultra-premium fuel designed for high-performance luxury cars and superbikes. Its availability at Sher Service Station is a strong indicator of the 'wealth effect' in its immediate catchment (Janakpuri). Only a fraction of IOCL outlets in Delhi are authorized to sell XP100, marking this station as a 'Flagship' or 'A-Class' outlet.

fuelTypes.name: XP95
fuelTypes.significance: With the implementation of BS-VI emission norms and the increasing number of turbocharged engines in mid-range cars, XP95 has become a standard requirement. Stocking this ensures customer retention among modern car owners.

fuelTypes.name: XtraGreen Diesel
fuelTypes.significance: This additive-enhanced diesel appeals to the environmentally conscious fleet operators and new-generation diesel luxury vehicles, offering better combustion and lower noise.

fuelTypes.name: Compressed Natural Gas (CNG)
fuelTypes.significance: This is the volume driver. Given the mandatory conversion of public transport to CNG in Delhi, this facility ensures a relentless stream of auto-rickshaws and taxis. However, this high volume is also the primary source of congestion on the forecourt.

evChargingDetails: Unconfirmed/Passive. While search tags associated with the station mention 'Level 2 AC Electric Vehicle Charging Stations', there is no definitive confirmation of an active, high-speed DC charger on site.

safetyCompliance.details: Issued vide letter No. F6/DFS/MS/2016/WZ/1292 on September 18, 2016, and renewed on May 3, 2019. Sh. Bhim Singh was the Sales Manager representing the station during the 2019 audit.

staffEstimate: The station is mandated to maintain trained staff available round-the-clock, as implied by the requirement for functioning fire suppression systems and unobstructed escape routes.
forecourt: High congestion on Pankha Road, serving as a primary traffic drainage channel for West Delhi. The station is located at Lock No 1539, Pankha Road, Near Janak Cinema, Janakpuri, New Delhi - 110058. Congestion due to stalled Janakpuri Flyover project and proximity to Sagarpur bottleneck/Janak Setu maintenance work. Peak Hours: 08:30 AM – 11:00 AM and 05:30 PM – 09:30 PM identified as 'Red Zones' for friction.
